privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1:
This digital service (the "App"), available through the web app, App Store and Google Play, is operated by:

• Data Controller: Sergio Álvaro Sampedro
• ID/TAX ID: [ID/TAX ID]
• Address: Calle Pintor Salvador Abril, 11 – 46006, Valencia
• Contact email: privacy@souschef.app

The App allows users to generate recipes using artificial intelligence tools based on text, culinary preferences and/or images of ingredients.
privacy.s2:
Depending on your use of the App, we may process the following categories of data:

a) Account and registration data
• Name or username
• Email address
• Encrypted password (cryptographic hash)
• Account creation date and activity
• Internal user identifiers

b) App usage data
• Culinary preferences
• Manually entered ingredients
• Generated recipes
• Basic interaction history with the app
• Language and regional settings

c) Images and content uploaded by the user

When you use ingredient recognition features via images:
• Images are automatically processed to detect ingredients and generate recipes
• Unless expressly stated otherwise, images are not stored permanently and are processed temporarily in memory or for the time strictly necessary to provide the service
• We recommend not uploading images that include unnecessary personal data or visible sensitive information

d) Technical and device data
• IP address
• Device type and operating system
• Session technical identifiers
• Browser and version
• Technical and security logs
• Aggregated or pseudonymized analytical data

e) Subscription and payment data

In case of premium features or subscriptions:
• Subscription status
• Payment identifiers
• Basic billing information

Payments are processed by specialized external providers and we do not store complete bank card data.
privacy.s3:
We process your data for the following purposes:

Purpose | Legal basis
————————————————————————
Create and manage your account | Performance of contract (Art. 6.1.b GDPR)
Generate recipes and AI features | Performance of contract (Art. 6.1.b GDPR)
Process images to detect ingredients | Performance of contract (Art. 6.1.b GDPR)
Maintain the security of the App | Legitimate interest (Art. 6.1.f GDPR)
Analyze performance and improve the service | Legitimate interest (Art. 6.1.f GDPR)
Manage payments and subscriptions | Performance of contract (Art. 6.1.b GDPR)
Comply with legal obligations | Legal obligation (Art. 6.1.c GDPR)
Send commercial communications (if applicable) | Consent (Art. 6.1.a GDPR)
privacy.s4:
The App uses artificial intelligence models to generate recipes, culinary suggestions and related results.

You should be aware that:
• Responses generated by AI may contain errors, inaccuracies or incomplete results
• Recipes are offered solely for informational and culinary assistance purposes
• We do not guarantee the absence of allergens, cross-contamination or suitability for specific dietary needs
• The user remains responsible for verifying ingredients, cooking times, nutritional values and dietary restrictions
privacy.s5:
In general:
• Account data will be retained as long as you keep your account active
• Subscription and billing data will be retained for the legally required periods
• Technical and security logs will be retained for the time strictly necessary to ensure security and traceability
• Images uploaded for ingredient detection may be automatically deleted after processing
• Generated recipes may be retained associated with your account while you use the service

When you delete your account, your personal data will be deleted or anonymized unless there is a legal obligation to retain it.
privacy.s6:
We may share data with technology providers who act as data processors, including:
• Cloud and infrastructure providers
• Authentication services
• Analytical tools
• AI processing providers
• Payment gateways
• Technical support services

In particular, the App may use third-party services such as:
• OpenAI
• Google Cloud
• Apple
• Google Play

Some providers may be located outside the European Economic Area. In such cases, we will apply valid international transfer mechanisms in accordance with Articles 44 and following of GDPR, including standard contractual clauses or providers adhered to applicable adequacy mechanisms.
privacy.s7: The App is not intended for children under 14 years of age. Minors should not create accounts or use the service without authorization from their parents or legal guardians.
privacy.s8:
We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect personal information, including:
• Encryption in transit via HTTPS/TLS
• Access control
• Secure credential management
• Security monitoring and logs
• Internal access segmentation
• Incident detection and mitigation measures

However, no system is completely infallible and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacy.s9:
You may exercise the following rights:
• Access
• Rectification
• Erasure
• Objection
• Limitation of processing
• Portability
• Withdrawal of consent

To exercise them, you can write to:

privacy@souschef.app

You may also file a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency:

[Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD)](https://www.aepd.es)
privacy.s10:
The App uses cookies and similar technologies to:
• Maintain authenticated sessions
• Ensure technical functionality
• Analyze usage and performance
• Remember preferences

You can consult more information in the Cookie Policy.
privacy.s11: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. When changes are relevant, we will inform you through the App itself, email or equivalent mechanisms.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.s1:
Cookies are small files that are stored on your device when you browse or use a web application.

They serve to allow the technical functioning of the service, remember preferences, analyze usage or customize certain features.
cookies.s2Title: 2. What types of cookies we use
cookies.s2:
a) Technical or strictly necessary cookies

They allow:
• Login
• Maintain authenticated sessions
• Ensure security and stability
• Remember basic preferences
• Load balancing and technical operation

These cookies do not require consent according to Article 22.2 of the LSSI-CE.

b) Analytical cookies

We may use our own or third-party analytical tools to:
• Measure feature usage
• Detect errors
• Improve performance and user experience
• Obtain aggregated statistics

When these cookies are not strictly necessary, prior consent will be requested.

c) Third-party cookies

The App may integrate third-party services that install their own cookies, including:
• Google
• Apple
• Stripe
• Analytical or authentication tools

Information about such cookies will depend on each provider's own policies.
cookies.s3:
The use of technical cookies is based on legitimate interest and technical necessity to provide the service.

Non-necessary cookies will only be installed when the user gives their consent.
cookies.s4:
You can:
• Accept all cookies
• Reject non-necessary cookies
• Configure preferences
• Withdraw consent later

Withdrawal of consent will not affect the lawfulness of prior processing.
cookies.s5Title: 5. How to disable cookies from the browser
cookies.s5:
You can configure your browser to block or delete cookies.

Official information from major browsers:
• Google Chrome
• Safari
• Mozilla Firefox
• Microsoft Edge

Keep in mind that blocking certain cookies may affect the App's functionality.
cookies.s6:
Some technology providers may process data outside the European Economic Area.

When international transfer exists, we will apply adequate safeguards in accordance with GDPR.
cookies.s7:
We may update this Cookie Policy when there are technical, regulatory or functional changes.

The current version will always be available in the App.
